verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਬਿਸਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gursikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap at prem kai parasapar bisam sathaan hai ||

en.bdb: The importance of assembling in the company of obedient disciples of the True Guru is very significant. Because of love with the True Guru, this place is wonderful.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਕੈ ਦਰਸ ਕੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹਰੀ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਤ ਸੁਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhirasaT dharas kai dharas kai dhirasaT haree herat hiraat sudh rahat na dhiaan hai ||

en.bdb: The disciple of the Guru looks for a glimpse of the True Guru. Because of a sight of the True Guru, his attention from other interests wane away. By His glimpse, he becomes unaware of all that is around him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਸਬਦ ਹਰੇ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਗਤਿ ਰਹਤ ਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh kai surat surat kai sabadh hare kahat sunat gat rahat na giaan hai ||

en.bdb: In the company of Guru's disciples, one hears the melody of Guru's words and that dispels listening of other melodies cram the mind. In the listening and uttering of Guru's words, one does not like to listen to or hear any other knowledge.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਬਿਸਿਮਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਦੇਹ ਕੈ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਉਨਮਨ ਮਧੁ ਪਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੨੬੩॥
verses.translit_en: asan basan tan man bisimaran hui dheh kai bidheh unaman madh paan hai ||263||

en.bdb: In this divine state, a Guru's Sikh forgets all his physical needs of eating, wearing, sleeping etc. He becomes free from physical adorations and relishes the Naam Amrit, ever living an ecstatic state. (263)
